title: Return streamed Ollama tool calls from #chat

files.patch:
@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@
 - [SECURITY]: A change which fixes a security vulnerability.
 
 ## [Unreleased]
+- [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1062] Return the tool calls of every streamed chunk from `Langchain::LLM::Ollama#chat` instead of only the last chunk's, which has none, so `Langchain::Assistant` runs tools with streaming on.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1061] Pass `max_completion_tokens` and `reasoning_effort` through `Langchain::LLM::OpenAI#chat` and `Langchain::LLM::Azure#chat` instead of dropping them; OpenAI's reasoning models reject `max_tokens`, so their output couldn't be capped.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1060] Find `functionCall` and text parts anywhere in a `GoogleGeminiResponse`, so a tool call that follows text is run instead of ending the `Langchain::Assistant` run, a text part after a call no longer raises `NoMethodError`, and `chat_completion` joins every text part and leaves out thought summaries.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1058] Pass Anthropic `thinking` and `redacted_thinking` blocks back, first and unchanged, in the assistant turn of `Langchain::Assistant`'s tool-use loop; dropping them made the request carrying the tool result fail whenever Claude thought before calling a tool.

@@ -303,12 +303,16 @@ def generate_final_completion_response(responses_stream, model)
       Langchain::LLM::Response::OllamaResponse.new(final_response, model: model)
     end
 
-    # BUG: If streamed, this method does not currently return the tool_calls response.
+    # Ollama streams each tool call in a chunk of its own, before the final `done` chunk, which has none.
     def generate_final_chat_completion_response(responses_stream, model)
       final_response = responses_stream.last
-      final_response["message"]["content"] = responses_stream.map { |resp| resp.dig("message", "content") }.join
+      message = final_response["message"].merge(
+        "content" => responses_stream.map { |resp| resp.dig("message", "content") }.join
+      )
+      tool_calls = responses_stream.flat_map { |resp| Array(resp.dig("message", "tool_calls")) }
+      message["tool_calls"] = tool_calls if tool_calls.any?
 
-      Langchain::LLM::Response::OllamaResponse.new(final_response, model: model)
+      Langchain::LLM::Response::OllamaResponse.new(final_response.merge("message" => message), model: model)
     end
   end
 end

@@ -150,6 +150,31 @@
         expect(streamed_responses).to be_all { |resp| resp.is_a?(Langchain::LLM::Response::OllamaResponse) }
         expect(streamed_responses.map(&:chat_completion).join).to include("I'm just a language model")
       end
+
+      context "when the model calls tools" do
+        # Ollama streams each tool call in a chunk of its own, before the final `done` chunk, which has none.
+        let(:chunks) do
+          [
+            {message: {role: "assistant", content: "", tool_calls: [{function: {name: "weather__execute", arguments: {city: "Paris"}}}]}, done: false},
+            {message: {role: "assistant", content: "", tool_calls: [{function: {name: "weather__execute", arguments: {city: "Rome"}}}]}, done: false},
+            {message: {role: "assistant", content: ""}, done_reason: "stop", done: true, prompt_eval_count: 10, eval_count: 5}
+          ]
+        end
+
+        before do
+          body = chunks.map { |chunk| chunk.merge(model: "llama3.2").to_json }.join("\n")
+          allow(client).to receive(:post).with("api/chat", hash_including(stream: true)) do |&block|
+            request = Struct.new(:options).new(Faraday::RequestOptions.new)
+            block.call(request)
+            request.options.on_data.call(body, body.bytesize)
+          end
+        end
+
+        it "returns the tool calls from every chunk" do
+          expect(response.tool_calls.map { |call| call.dig("function", "arguments", "city") }).to eq(["Paris", "Rome"])
+          expect(response.completion_tokens).to eq(5)
+        end
+      end
     end
   end
